property_summary: On the first deposit of 1 wei by the creator, the reference contract succeeds while the buggy contract reverts due to the flipped assertion.
change_summary: Replace assert(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value > balances[msg.sender]) with assert(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value < balances[msg.sender]) to make assertion always false, causing revert on any deposit.
